Brian Stewart critiques film DISCLOSURE DAY and Tulsi Gabbard supporters in new tweets
Ohio State Representative Brian Stewart, a Republican legislator and Iraq War veteran representing District 12, shared his views on recent topics in a series of posts on June 24, 2026.
On June 24, Stewart posted, "It’s time to get his wins back." Later that day, he criticized the film DISCLOSURE DAY by writing, "DISCLOSURE DAY is quite bad. The script is absurd, the direction is head-scratching, the leads are miscast, and the entire thing is just trite, cutesy, self-satisfied nonsense. It’s in the running for Spielberg’s worst movie, and I say that as a super-fan." In another post from June 24, Stewart commented on online supporters of Tulsi Gabbard: "Tulsi groupies online are just utterly disconnected from reality. She’s only about 10% as popular in real life as they believe her to be."
Stewart has served as an infantry veteran in the Iraq War and earned honors including the Combat Infantryman’s Badge and two Army Commendation Medals (official website). He represents Madison and Pickaway counties along with part of western Franklin County. In addition to his legislative work—such as co-chairing the first meeting of the Ohio Redistricting Commission—he has expressed personal interests in movies, sports, target shooting, American history books, and Johnny Cash.
